checks.name: reverse usage includes SDK sharing and exact A/C -> B -> D paths, not every compatible range
a real browser reports its immutable composition and protects not-yet-loaded C dependencies
switching D leaves the older tab and rollback snapshot visible as blockers for the old version
an expired heartbeat becomes unknown and still prevents deletion instead of being counted unused
management UI shows the old version consumers, tab evidence and concrete deletion blockers
saving a support end date and notice reference persists metadata without changing service selection
concurrent support-policy edits are rejected and cannot silently overwrite another manager
invalid dates, unknown artifacts, cross-origin writes and missing tokens cannot alter policy
usage reports reject foreign artifacts, replayed reports cannot reopen a closed session, and BFCache stays reserved
retirement assessment enforces Korean date boundaries, notice, observation, retention and every reference type
support metadata and usage evidence survive a server restart
search and filters work on mobile with labeled controls and no page overflow
support ending preserves files but blocks reintroducing the release through rollback
all original service builds, published bytes and the live composition remain unchanged

scope: Local usage graph and actual browser heartbeats, lifecycle UI/API, deterministic policy clock checks; no file deletion or production-wide absence proof.
